title: Life Cycles of Sun-like and Massive Stars
author: NASA; Night Sky Network
license_observation: The asset credits NASA and Night Sky Network. No item-specific permission grant was observed; a NASA URL is not treated as a license.
figure: Full single illustration, asset STScI-01HVSD3PAQ79QDG9FMDZKVFTQ2; no crop.
object_count_basis: Twelve principal stages/illustrated objects, counting the two mass-dependent protostar branches separately in the native model.
reading_path: From the shared central nebula, follow the lower-mass left loop or higher-mass right loop; the latter splits into two remnants. Return arrows connect expelled material to the nebula.
merit: The double-loop composition makes different stellar timescales and outcomes visible at once. Varied celestial silhouettes, scale, pale cyan labels, and generous black space provide hierarchy without boxes.
preview_note: Full original retained; proportional 1800-pixel-long-edge PNG preview.
